children: According to CNBC, Costco Wholesale reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $95.72 billion, up 11.1% from a year earlier and above Wall Street estimates of $94.86 billion, while adjusted earnings per share rose 15% to $6.75 and also topped expectations. Membership fee income increased 7.3% to $1.85 billion, slightly below FactSet estimates, and paid memberships rose 3.8% to 84.1 million, missing expectations as the company continued to face questions about membership growth and renewal trends.

Worldwide renewal rates edged up to 89.8% from 89.7% in the prior three quarters, while the U.S. and Canada rate rose to 92.3% from 92.2%. Executive memberships climbed to 42.3 million, a record high. CEO Ron Vachris said renewal rates improved again and that higher executive membership penetration should help future renewal rates. Costco also said digitally enabled comparable sales rose 19.5% and that it opened 12 new warehouses in the quarter, or 11 excluding a relocation in Taiwan.

title: Costco Beats Fourth-Quarter Estimates as Membership Growth Slows
